title: TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Project Time by Person Level
content:
Project level schedule of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours: the block hours of a group of architect lines are figured at the block's architect ratio, those of a group of senior engineer lines at the senior engineer ratio, and those of any other group at the technician ratio. The level is the person level the group's lines carry on the Professional Services Projects work log.

| Group's lines | Ratio |
|---|---|
| architect | architect ratio of the size |
| senior engineer | senior engineer ratio of the size |
| technician | technician ratio of the size |

Hypothetical case on a TimeBank 160-Hour Block (architect ratio 1.5, senior engineer ratio 1.25, technician ratio 1.0) for a business-hours group of 120 minutes: 3.00 hours for architect lines, 2.50 hours for senior engineer lines, 2.00 hours for technician lines.
